title: modular LED signaling hardware

specimens.name: Flush multicolor LED status puck
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 1 ONLY. One isolated unpowered specimen. One low round metal puck with three small red, amber and green translucent sectors in its face, short threaded panel barrel. No projecting beacon dome.

specimens.name: Modular stack-light segment
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 2 ONLY. One isolated unpowered specimen. One short cylindrical ribbed amber lens segment with black bayonet base and visible twist-lock tabs. One segment only, no tower or stacked lenses.

specimens.name: Directional warning chevron optic
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 3 ONLY. One isolated unpowered specimen. One detached solid amber V-shaped chevron lens with molded optical facets, short retention tabs, no housing or printed arrow.

specimens.name: Equipment-ready ring-light collar
specimens.description: TOP ROW CELL 4 ONLY. One isolated unpowered specimen. One thin annular green-tinted light collar with a large open central hole and dark mounting lip, viewed obliquely. The hole must be clear.

specimens.name: Dual-chamber fault indicator
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 1 ONLY. One isolated unpowered specimen. One compact oblong sealed case with exactly two discrete recessed lens chambers side by side, dark red left and amber right, opaque separator between them.

specimens.name: Illuminated-button LED insert
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 2 ONLY. One isolated unpowered specimen. One small naked square graphite light-engine module with a single central pale emitter die and two short electrical terminals. No pushbutton cap, frame or switch.

specimens.name: Compact strobe emitter
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 3 ONLY. One isolated unpowered specimen. One compact square open metal strobe module with a deep faceted silver reflector cup, small emitter at the center, and one short attached driver block at rear. No flash effect.

specimens.name: Light-pipe terminal fixture
specimens.description: BOTTOM ROW CELL 4 ONLY. One isolated unpowered specimen. One small L-shaped clear molded optical waveguide end with visible right-angle bend, polished round output end and integral retaining clip. No emitter board.

global_forbidden: text, labels, logos, footer, titles or printed style instructions anywhere
light emission, beams, flash, glow or halos
whole fixtures from the previous LED lighting sheet, duplicate objects, whole assembled signaling towers or scenes
E2 tall incandescent beacons or exposed cabling
E4 or E5 futuristic or holographic effects

era_contract.character: E3 2015 modular spaceport signaling components with shallow housings, graphite seals, precision molded colored optics, replaceable emitters and passive light guides. HD pixel art.
required_signals: Exactly eight unpowered objects in order, each centered with generous gaps in its own cell
Lens color is passive material tint, never visible light emission
Round puck, annular collar, cylindrical bayonet segment and angular chevron must have different silhouettes
Keep naked button insert distinct from the strobe reflector and clear light pipe
Canvas contains only the eight specimens and neutral blank background, no text
replaced_previous_language: Preserve physical lens color and service access
Replace bulky incandescent signal housings with compact modular LED optics and keyed mounts
Add passive waveguides and replaceable light-engine inserts for dense equipment panels
forbidden_regressions: Recolor-only era change or repeated LED fixtures
Glow, beam, flash, symbols printed on the devices
